intent: A basalt-black plate set with dim ember-gold trim and one bright gold crown point, wide molten seams across the tilted pauldron tops and down the breast, and a heavy black war-cape; from the high camera it reads as a black winged-shoulder silhouette cut by orange seams, apart from every other family.
requests: A cape that hangs and swings from the shoulders; rigid parts only, so it is a back mantle and thigh tails.
An open circlet for the crown; a box band still reads as a solid cap from above even dimmed.
